spec2def(cfgmgr32.dll cfgmgr32.spec)

# cfgmgr32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cfgmgr32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(cfgmgr32 cfgmgr32-cargo cfgmgr32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
